name: ledger
wording: the record of a project's cuts and work packages, each change of state taken as it happens from what the harness saw its agents do, never from an agent remembering. A work package is dispatched and returned with its builder and approved once every assayer judging it passes it, a finding sending it back to build and a disagreement holding it until the architect settles it; a cut is in flight from its first dispatch, complete when all its work packages are approved, and integrated once that is recorded, whatever their last states; every state and what is ready next are computed from it, on the cut's own branch.
reason: Restated as current meaning only: plain words, with decision numbers, history and how it is built left out; its meaning is unchanged.
